tools.name: gst_hst_small_supplier_check
tools.description: Apply the CRA's $30,000 small-supplier tests (single calendar quarter and four consecutive calendar quarters) to taxable revenue by calendar quarter. Says whether the person must register for the GST/HST, when they stop being a small supplier, the effective date of registration, and headroom for nex

tools.name: gst_hst_rate_by_province
tools.description: Current GST/HST rate for a Canadian province or territory (or all 13), with the PST/QST rate CRA lists for reference. From CRA's 'Charge and collect the GST/HST' table. Returns structuredContent with one rate row (or all 13), the effective-from date, notes, the canada.ca source and an as-of date.

tools.name: cra_automobile_allowance_rate
